silkroad.client.general.enabled.desc: Turns all Silkroad camera smoothing on or off.
silkroad.client.general.maxLagDistance.d: Caps how far the camera spring can lag behind its target.
silkroad.client.firstPerson.desc: Smoothing used while playing in first person.
silkroad.client.firstPerson.rotationEnab: Visually smooths first-person yaw and pitch without changing player rotation.
silkroad.client.firstPerson.verticalEnab: Adds a vertical spring to first-person jumps and falls.
silkroad.client.thirdPerson.desc: Smoothing used while the camera is behind the player.
silkroad.client.thirdPerson.positionLagE: Lets the third-person camera gently follow player movement.
silkroad.client.thirdPerson.positionFreq: Higher values make the third-person camera catch up faster.
silkroad.client.thirdPerson.rotationEnab: Visually smooths third-person yaw and pitch before the vanilla camera orbit is placed.
silkroad.client.thirdPerson.stepUpSmooth: Smooths the local player model when stepping up blocks in third person.
silkroad.client.thirdPerson.ignoreCrouch: Keeps the third-person camera anchor at standing eye height while crouching.
silkroad.client.aiming.desc: Controls how Silkroad behaves while aiming or using compatible camera mods.
silkroad.client.aiming.disableWhileAimin: Smoothly removes camera offsets while aiming, scoping, or free-looking.
silkroad.client.aiming.blendOutSpeed.des: Higher values fade camera smoothing out faster while aiming.
silkroad.client.aiming.itemNamespaces.de: Item namespaces treated as aiming-capable while the use key is held.
silkroad.client.aiming.itemIds.desc: Full item IDs treated as aiming-capable while the use key is held.
silkroad.client.compatibility.desc: Optional behavior for other installed mods.
silkroad.client.compatibility.pehkuiEnab: Scales compatible camera offsets with Pehkui entity size when Pehkui is installed.
silkroad.client.advanced.desc: Detailed spring and snap tuning. Defaults are tuned for normal play.
silkroad.client.advanced.firstPersonRota: Higher values make first-person rotation smoothing more responsive.
Controls how strongly first-person rotation springs settle.
silkroad.client.advanced.firstPersonVert: Higher values settle first-person vertical smoothing faster.
Snaps first-person vertical smoothing to the target below this offset.
Lower values make jumps feel heavier.
Controls how strongly the first-person vertical spring settles.
silkroad.client.advanced.thirdPersonPosi: Controls how strongly the third-person position spring settles.
silkroad.client.advanced.thirdPersonVert: Higher values settle third-person vertical smoothing faster.
Snaps third-person vertical smoothing to the target below this offset.
silkroad.client.advanced.thirdPersonRota: Higher values make third-person rotation smoothing more responsive.
Controls how strongly third-person rotation springs settle.
silkroad.client.advanced.thirdPersonStep: Minimum upward tick movement treated as a visual step-up.
Maximum upward tick movement treated as a visual step-up.
How quickly the visual player model catches up after a step-up.
Snaps visual step-up smoothing to the target below this offset.
Resets step-up smoothing when Y changes farther than this many blocks.
silkroad.client.advanced.resetDistance.d: Resets springs when the target camera position jumps farther than this many blocks.
silkroad.client.experimental.desc: New behavior that may change between versions.
silkroad.client.experimental.thirdPerson: Uses Silkroad's experimental third-person rig instead of the vanilla final camera position.
Minimum camera distance used by the experimental third-person rig.
Maximum camera distance used by the experimental third-person rig.
Small distance kept from block collision when the experimental rig clips the camera.
